summary.text: Lynne Russo is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 117 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Chelsea Walsh.
Her Ballotpedia survey response describes her as a community advocate in Western North Carolina who has worked for national nonprofits.

paragraphs.text: Russo earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Minnesota, according to Ballotpedia.

Her Ballotpedia survey response says she has helped national nonprofits raise millions of dollars over her career, including work with The Education Trust, the Milken Family Foundation and the Prostate Cancer Foundation.
It says that after Hurricane Helene she mobilized national support for Appalachian families and advocated for long-term recovery funding for the region.
